description: Bridge closed allowlist policy for Gemini CLI. See references/security-model.md M2.
notes: sandbox_mode=plan and max_tool_calls=0 together make the CLI read-only.
For v1 kinds (review, research, prompt) Gemini never needs to execute tools; it only generates text responses from the assembled prompt.
If a future kind requires tool execution, generate a new policy file for that kind rather than relaxing this one.
